newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Merchants sells unit for US$5.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: China Merchants sells unit for US$5.6 mln.

text.p: China Merchants China Direct Investments Ltd said on Monday it has agreed to sell its entire 100 percent stake in China Faith International Ltd for US$5.61 million to an independent third party.
It said the sale would enable the company to make a profit of about US$750,000.

China Faith holds a 25 percent stake in each of three Sino-foreign joint ventures in China, includes Shenzhen Anda Container Transportation Co Ltd, Shenzhen Anda Cargo Transportation Co Ltd, and Shenzhen Anda Passenger Transportation Co Ltd.
China Merchants China Direct Investment is a closed-end investment company focusing on direct investment in China.
